apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: Pip is now a sticker: bold outline, white die-cut border and a hand-drawn wobble. Tap Pip anywhere and he peels off the page and sticks back down. New app icon and widget to match.
